reasoning: We have a classic rate problem. 7 printers take 7 minutes to print 7 posters. So each printer prints 1 poster in 7 minutes? Let's analyze: If 7 printers produce 7 posters in 7 minutes, that implies each printer prints 1 poster in 7 minutes. So printer rate = 1 poster per 7 minutes = 1/7 posters per minute. For 21 printers, same rate per printer. So total rate = 21 * (1/7) = 3 posters per minute. To print 21 posters at 3 per minute takes 21 / 3 = 7 minutes. So answer: 7 minutes. Alternatively, scaling: If printers and posters scale proportionally, time stays same. So answer: 7 minutes.
